endpoint.name: ChatGPT answer — text, sources, ads, shopping
endpoint.summary: Runs a prompt through the live ChatGPT web interface from a chosen country and returns the answer text with its cited sources, citation pills, brand entities, shopping cards and sponsored ads as structured fields.
endpoint.call_template: treg call cloro.ai-search.chatgpt.scrape --method POST --data '{"prompt":"what is a stock split","country":"US","include":{"markdown":true,"html":true,"rawResponse":true,"searchQueries":true,"ads":true,"shopping":true}}'

cost.note: 9 = 5 base + 2 for the include.rawResponse / searchQueries / ads / shopping family (charged once, however many of the four are set) + the 2-credit sync surcharge every /v1/monitor/* call carries. A plain call with none of those four flags is 7. `state` adds 2 more. Setting the ads/shopping flags is what is billed; whether those blocks actually render is a separate matter — they appear on the desktop UI, which `legacy: true` (free) selects. A failed extraction is not charged.

prompt.example: best running shoes for flat feet

country.note: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. CN, CZ, HK, IR, MO, RU and VE are refused.

state.note: US state code for state-level targeting; adds 2 credits

legacy.note: serve the desktop UI, where ads and shopping render; free. Defaults to the mobile-web UI.

disableWebSearch.note: answer from the model alone, without a web search

include.note: any of markdown, html, rawResponse, searchQueries, ads, shopping. markdown and html are free; setting any of rawResponse / searchQueries / ads / shopping adds 2 credits once, however many of the four are set.

endpoint.capability_description: Scrape a live ChatGPT answer page for a keyword

samples.reason: Local-business prompt with state targeting returned the named businesses, a structured map list showing the Yelp/Google feed behind them, and directory citations. Good for local AEO baselines.
A plain call cost 7 credits and returned the answer text, an ordered source list with footnote flags, and citation pills. Good for brand citation checks.
ChatGPT scrape returned answer text, ordered source list and citation pills in one cheap call; markdown include worked.

siblings.name: ChatGPT's answer to a question
siblings.summary: What ChatGPT answers a logged-out visitor for one question, as one row: the answer as Markdown and as plain text, the sources it cited and the pages its web search read. For brand monitoring and AI-search visibility: does ChatGPT name you, and which pages does it cite. `prompt` is the question; `web_search` lets ChatGPT search the web first (default on); `country` asks from that country. About 30 s to 2 minutes. Columns: prompt, answer, answer_text, citations, sources, web_search_used, asked_at.
siblings.call_template: treg call crawl4ai.ai-search.chatgpt.scrape --method POST --data '{"prompt":"What are the best open-source web crawlers for LLM pipelines?"}'

cost.note: treg's account price: 3.2 credits a call whatever pages the run fetched, second-source records included; a reply with no rows, a refused input and a failed run are free. The x-c4-cost header settles the actual charge.

prompt.example: What are the best open-source web crawlers for LLM pipelines?

body.prompt: What are the best open-source web crawlers for LLM pipelines?
